frame0: AI IS MAKING YOUR NEXT LAPTOP PRICIER

shots.note:
HOME BASE, COZY nook · POV · PULL OUT 5%
Each memory stick that flies to the AI data center = your laptop's price up one step

INSERT chart, straight-on
20 years: the same money bought more computer

MEDIUM, waist-up (the face)
Right after you buy one, a BETTER one comes out for the same $999

INSERT, the exact S4 frame
This year the line turns UP: +9.7%

CLOSE at your desk, COZY lamp
Your laptop runs on the memory stick inside it

EXTREME CLOSE cut-in, SCALE 1/3
ONE stick of memory chips, the biggest thing in frame

SCALE 2/3: RISE over OUR ROOF (the big move)
Grey slab = OUR ROOF dropping away; the AI data center is too big for the frame; sticks pour in

SCALE 3/3: CUT to WORM'S-EYE, tiny you
Their mountain of memory towers 10:1 over you and your one stick

MEDIUM-WIDE, slightly high: the QUEUE
They pay more: the data center is first at the chip factory door; the laptop van waits behind

INSERT bars, straight-on
What's left costs 5x last year

CLOSE on the tag
Laptop makers pass it on: $999 struck, $1,099 on 'pass'

HOME BASE returns, COZY · MEDIUM-WIDE
Normally you'd sit and wait for the better one; the data center stays outside

MEDIUM-WIDE, the exact S10 frame
Chip makers: 2027 is worse. A 2nd data center cuts in; the laptop van is pushed back

HOME BASE callback = O1's end, COZY
That's how the AI data center ends up on your price

CLOSE-UP cut-in on S15's tag, COZY
The tag turns over: an AI data center on its back

DISSOLVE back to frame 0 (the loop)
The opening's bare lines redraw, so the rewatch starts seamlessly
